content.title: Prehypertensive stratification
content.body: Photoplethysmographic waveform analysis (light-based pulse sensing) yielded an estimated systolic determination of 128/84 mmHg concomitant with a chronotropic index of approximately 72 bpm, a constellation consistent with prehypertensive stratification (slightly raised blood pressure) necessitating confirmatory oscillometric sphygmomanometry, and the normal reference range sits below 120 over 80. This constitutes a screening signal and not a diagnosis. Please consult a physician within 7 days.
recommendations: Book a confirmatory cuff measurement within 7 days.
Record morning readings for one week.
